li (CorpX): Hey team, hitting high tail latency on /v1/embeddings for corpX. 99th ~6s, median ~120ms. Happens intermittently when we send mixed payloads. Also saw a few dimension-mismatch errors (client expects 1024 but server returns 1536). Anyone seen this with dynamic batching + max_batch_size?

alex (Support): Thanks — can you paste a sanitized sample request + headers, and tell us model + max_batch_size + whether dynamic batching is enabled on your side? Also which SDK version?

li (CorpX): Sample (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
{"model":"embed-large-v1","input":["short text","very long doc..."],"max_batch_size":64}
```

We toggle dynamic batching on (default). SDK v2.1.0. Bulk requests include both short blurbs and long docs; hope that's not the issue.

maria (SRE): Looking at router logs: we see a spike in mixed_shape_fallback events at 2026-07-18T10:32Z. Stack shows dynamic_batcher detected heterogeneous output dims and triggered per-request fallback path (sync flush), which bypasses fast batched kernel and hits slow-path per-sample processing. Correlates with tail latency. Snippet from logs: `dynamic_batcher: grouping failed (mixed_shape) -> fallback sync_flush`.

jeff (ML Eng): That matches a known edge-case: if inputs in a coalesced batch would produce different embedding dimensionalities (due to model variant/prefixing or client mixing models), the batcher currently falls back to a conservative path. There's an open fix to group by output_dim prior to batch coalescing (PR in review).

alex (Support): Do we have repro steps we can give the customer so they can confirm? Li, can you run a minimized repro?

li (CorpX): Did a quick repro: send 200 requests with mixed short/long inputs and alternating model names (I was testing different model aliases). Results: ~10% dimMismatch errors, ~5% explicit "embedding dimension mismatch" exceptions, and tail latency spike to 6-8s for affected requests. Curl snippet I used: `for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST ... -d @payload.json; done` (payload alternates small vs large).

maria (SRE): Also noticed a separate 401 event earlier from the same key around 10:20Z due to key rotation on the customer's side — unrelated but noisy in the same window. I've isolated logs for just successful authenticated requests to analyze batching behavior.

jeff (ML Eng): Short-term workarounds: 1) Have the client ensure a single model + consistent expected embedding dim per request stream (avoid mixing model aliases that map to different dims). 2) As a quick config: set max_batch_size=1 for that client's route so dynamic coalescing can't create mixed-dimension batches. 3) Alternatively, split requests on the client side into two queues by expected dim. Medium-term: deploy PR that groups by output_dim before coalescing.

alex (Support): Good. Can we detect this automatically? A metric/alert to catch future cases?

maria (SRE): Yes — I exported `mixed_shape_fallback_rate` per-route. It spiked to 0.12 at 10:32. I've added a temporary alert rule: if >0.05 for 5m, page oncall and notify support. Also tagged the route for corpX.

li (CorpX): Customer asked about billing impact — were they billed for the failed/slow calls?

alex (Support): Billing note: failed requests with error responses are not charged; successful responses are billed normally. I confirmed with finance for the window: failed calls were not billed. I'll confirm exact counts and follow up.

jeff (ML Eng): Timeline: PR #4289 (group-by-output-dim) passed unit tests, needs integration QA. ETA: 2 days to QA, 5 days to prod rollout (canary first). I've scheduled a short canary run once staging is green.

maria (SRE): Created INC-2026-092, uploaded sanitized payloads and logs, and started a canary of jeff's branch in staging. Early synthetic tests show ~90% reduction in tail latency for mixed-dim workloads.

alex (Support): Customer communication suggested actions: 1) Apply temporary setting max_batch_size=1 or split by dim (we'll provide SDK snippet), 2) We will schedule hotfix deploy and provide ETA, 3) We'll monitor and follow up with billing confirmation.

li (CorpX): Implemented max_batch_size=1 workaround — reporting immediate drop in 99th to ~200ms. They accepted that while hotfix is rolled out.

jeff (ML Eng): After prod rollout we'll send a short post-mortem with root cause: dynamic batcher coalesced mixed-dimension inputs and fell back to slow-path; fix groups by output_dim. Also adding better logging to make mixed-shape batches easier to triage.

deploybot: Canary deploy started for branch pr/4289 -> staging (canary=10%). Logs: canary_ok=1, regression_fail=0.

maria (SRE): Monitoring shows canary stable for 30m, synthetic mixed workloads show tail latency down from 6s to 300ms. I'll schedule prod canary tomorrow morning.

alex (Support): I'll send a customer-facing note summarizing the workaround and ETA. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

li (CorpX): Thanks everyone — marking this resolved for now on our side. Please update the incident when prod deploy is complete.

jeff (ML Eng): Will do. PR -> production deploy tracking in INC-2026-092.

maria (SRE): Follow-ups: improve metric name visibility, add alert runbook steps, add e2e test for mixed-dim batch.

alex (Support): Closing loop once prod is live and billing confirmation done. :white_check_mark:
